request_state.conjecture_spec: Beal Conjecture: For positive integers A, B, C, x, y, z with A^x + B^y = C^z and x, y, z >= 3, then gcd(A, B, C) > 1. Strictly requires x,y,z >= 3 (strictly hyperbolic defect 1/x + 1/y + 1/z - 1 <= -1/12). Primitive solutions (gcd(A,B,C)=1) must be non-existent.
request_state.title: KRAUS SIEVE MODULAR METHOD EXTENSION FOR SIGNATURE (3, 3, p) ON [5301, 5400]
request_state.claim: No non-trivial primitive solutions exist for signature (3, 3, p) for all prime exponents p in [5301, 5400].
request_state.method: Modular method level lowering to conductor 72, Kraus sieve relations at auxiliary primes q = 2kp + 1 with a_q(f) = 0 mod 2.
